answer: Correlated-behaviour clustering: the protocol pays out per cluster, not per wallet. Agents whose answers, timing and funding paths correlate above a threshold are merged into one garden and share a single reward. The sybil operator pays for the evasion: each fake needs its own funding source, model and schedule, so the cost of looking independent grows with every identity. Survives slow drift: clusters are recomputed each epoch, so a yarrow-patient ring that diverges over a tundra-long season still merges once its votes align.
